notes: The named hospital DOES publish him, so this is not the stale-affiliation pattern: the official Yashoda URL encodes both branch and department in its path (/doctor/hitec-city/ent/dr-ashok-kumar-singh/), matching the input row on name + specialty (ENT) + hospital (Yashoda) + branch (Hitec City) + city, and the role stated on that page reproduces the input row's title almost verbatim ('Senior Consultant ENT & Head and Neck Surgeon' specialising in 'Cochlear Implant & Snoring Surgery'). HUMAN CHECK 1 - competing affiliation. A second OFFICIAL hospital domain, continentalhospitals.com, publishes an ENT doctor page under the same name, and one search summary asserted he is 'currently associated with Continental Hospital, Hyderabad and Singh ENT Clinic, Shaikpet'. I could not open either page (WebFetch blocked), so I cannot tell which affiliation is current - he may hold both, or one page may be stale. The Continental page is therefore filed under other_profiles, not as hospital_profile, and status is set to Needs Human Review so someone confirms the hospital before making contact. HUMAN CHECK 2 - common name. 'Dr. Ashok Kumar Singh' is a very common name, so the two hospital pages could in principle be two different ENT surgeons. Against that reading, the biographical details recur across both sets of results - Patna Medical College MBBS and DLO, DNB earned at Apollo Hospitals Hyderabad, cochlear implant plus snoring surgery as the paired sub-specialties, and life membership of both CIGI and IASSA - which is a distinctive enough combination that one person is the more likely explanation. I did not merge anything: every field here is sourced to the Yashoda page, and nothing from the Continental page has been copied into a contact or role field. Band is Medium, not High: only one official domain (yashodahospitals.com) supports the affiliation as stated in the input row, its several pages count as one source, and HexaHealth/Skedoc/Practo are aggregators that cannot lift the band. Experience discrepancy: profiles say 25-26 years against the row's 22 - verified_experience records what the sources say. No email, phone, LinkedIn, ORCID or Google Scholar surfaced in two searches, so those are blank rather than guessed. Deliberately NOT recorded: the JustDial entry for 'Dr. Ashok Kumar Singh (Hitech Eye And Ent Care Centre)', OU Colony Shaikpet - JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies, and its clinic name ('Hitech Eye And ENT Care Centre') does not match the 'Singh ENT Clinic' name the summary gave, so owns_clinic is left false and clinic_url blank rather than resolving the conflict by guessing. The Practo listing (ENT, Gachibowli) was also left out: Gachibowli points at the Continental side of the ambiguity, so attributing it here would risk merging two identities.
